scope.description: Brokerage accounts in the Bridgewater, NJ market over $50,000 as of 8/31/2026

cio_guidance.note: Tier 2 and Tier 3 strategic targets are currently identical (confirmed).

judgment_calls.title: Margin
judgment_calls.text: Negative margin balances are left out of the allocation math and reported separately. Positive margin is counted as cash.

judgment_calls.title: Proxies
judgment_calls.text: Some holdings have no matching CMA asset class, so they are proxied: munis as U.S. corporates, EM debt as high yield. A column shows how much of each account relies on the muni proxy.

judgment_calls.title: Unclassified holdings
judgment_calls.text: Left out of the expected return and risk math. A coverage percentage is reported, so accounts with large unmapped holdings can be flagged rather than taken at face value.

judgment_calls.title: Snapshot timing
judgment_calls.text: Security classifications come from the 8/28 week-end snapshot. Accounts and positions are as of 8/31.

judgment_calls.title: Investor profile
judgment_calls.text: Derived from risk tolerance and time horizon using the 2-factor grid. The existing allocation_profile_desc sits next to it for comparison, because where that field comes from is not confirmed.

judgment_calls.title: Liquidity tier
judgment_calls.text: A direct lookup from the account's liquidity needs. Blank values default to Tier 0, the most liquid.

judgment_calls.title: Added for this POC
judgment_calls.text: Aggregate bond funds split 60/40 Treasuries/IG corporates; brokered CDs treated as cash; Sharpe uses the CMA cash return as the risk-free rate.

cma.note: Correlations come from a three-factor structure (equity, rates, credit) so the matrix is a valid correlation matrix.

dana.note: Illustrative POC data. Expected returns, volatilities, correlations, model weights, account setup and performance figures are assumptions, not CIO publications.
